description: Raw time series of one dataset's variables at a point, with unit labels: any gridded product (NBM, HRRR, RRFS, GFS, RTMA, MRMS, air quality, ...). Time modes: hours (default 24), time_start+time_end (ISO 8601), or latest=true (newest value). Up to 168 frames: when truncated, send next_cursor as cursor with the same arguments. reference_time pins a model run; each series reports its run (reference_time, or reference_times when runs mix); runs older than about 48 h may be gone. For blended forecasts use get_forecast. Examples: {"location": "Denver, CO", "dataset_id": "rrfs_surface", "variables": ["temperature_2m"], "hours": 18} or {"lat": 41.4, "lon": -92.9, "dataset_id": "rtma_conus", "variables": ["temperature_2m"], "latest": true}.

dataset_id.description: Default: the NBM dataset for the location (nbm_conus/nbm_alaska/nbm_hawaii). Discover with list_datasets.

hours.description: Hours from now (1-264): ahead, or back on analyses (default: newest 166 frames); from the run start with reference_time.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Most tools also accept a `location` place-name string instead of lat/lon.

latest.description: Only the newest value (analyses like RTMA/MRMS).

location.description: Free-text place: "City, ST" (e.g. "Portland, OR"), US ZIP, venue/address where enabled, or "lat,lon". Use this OR lat+lon, not both.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). For continental US use negative values (west of the prime meridian).

reference_time.description: Pin a specific model run (ISO 8601). Default: latest run.

variables.description: Standard names (e.g. temperature_2m, precipitation); see describe_dataset.

name: query_dataset

_sources.description: Per-source provenance: what produced these values and when.

attribution.description: Attribution the dataset licence requires. Cite it when quoting these values.

data_status.description: Present only when the data service did not answer and a cached copy was served.

reference_time.description: Model run behind every value in this series.

reference_times.description: Distinct runs, when this series mixes more than one.

related.description: With out_of_domain: a dataset that covers the point.

status.description: ok, unavailable, out_of_domain (see related) or not_public.

unit_labels.description: Unit of each variable in data.

title: Query dataset
